rounds.q: What % of Canadians live within 62 miles of the US border?
rounds.why: That narrow strip near the border covers only about 4% of Canada's land.
rounds.src: Statistics Canada, 2016 Census, The Daily, Feb 8 2017 (2016 data)
rounds.fun: Two out of three Canadians, all cozied up near the border!

rounds.q: About what % of the land borders between countries follow rivers?
rounds.why: South America has the most river borders at 43%. Asia has the fewest, at 18%.
rounds.src: CIA World Factbook, World entry: Land boundaries (final edition, 2025-26)
rounds.fun: One in four borders is a river. Bring a canoe to the border!

rounds.q: What % of Egyptians live within a few miles of the Nile River?
rounds.why: The Nile's river basin stretches across 11 countries.
rounds.fun: 95 out of 100 Egyptians stick close to the Nile. Riverside is the place to be!

rounds.q: How many US states share a border with Canada?
rounds.why: Alaska has the longest stretch, 1,538 miles. Pennsylvania has just 42 miles.
rounds.fun: 13 states get to wave hello to Canada. Alaska gets the longest wave!

rounds.q: How tall is Mount Everest, in feet?
rounds.why: From its base on the sea floor, Hawaii's Mauna Kea is taller: over 33,500 feet.
rounds.src: China-Nepal official survey, Dec 2020 (via NPR); NOAA Ocean Service (current)
rounds.fun: 29,032 feet up! That's a lot of stairs, so pack snacks.
